task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use the right arm to set the mouse for cursor control right of the light gray rectangular cleaning soap.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框内使用右手臂将鼠标设置为浅灰色长方形清洁皂右侧的光标控制。
